entries.name: Agentstools Model Lookup
entries.description: Look up normalized metadata for one AI model by name or short alias — per-million input/output pricing, context and output limits, capability tags, modalities, knowledge cutoff, release date, provider list, and coding benchmark — fused from open keyless catalogs (LiteLLM, models.dev, Aider) with source citations.

name.description: Model name or short alias, e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5, gpt-4o, sonnet or 4o. Fuzzy-resolved to the closest catalog model.

outputSchema.description: One normalized model record. found:false (with 200) when the name is unknown.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/model/lookup?name=<model-name-or-alias>. Single required query param `name` (a model name or short alias, e.g. sonnet, 4o, claude-sonnet-4-5, gpt-4o). No request body. Result is inline in the 200. Pays $0.008 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453).
usage.outputShape: Single JSON model record. Key fields (verified live for name=sonnet -> claude-sonnet-4): found (boolean), query, id, name, provider, providers[] (all gateways carrying it), aliases[], price_in / price_out (USD per 1M tokens), prices.{input,output,cache_read}.{litellm,modelsdev} (per-source USD/1M), context (context window tokens), max_output (max output tokens), caps[] (e.g. tools, vision, reasoning, pdf, prompt_caching, structured_output), modalities.{input,output}[], knowledge_cutoff (date), release_date (date), benchmark / benchmarks (coding pass-rate object or null), citations[] (source + source_url + license), sources_used[], attribution[]. Unknown names return {"found":false, ...} with HTTP 200.
quirks: The `name` param is fuzzy alias-resolved to the closest catalog model, so the resolved record may not be the exact/latest variant you meant: name=sonnet resolved to id claude-sonnet-4 (not claude-sonnet-4-5). Pass a precise id/alias (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5) when you need an exact match.
An unknown model name returns a valid HTTP 200 with {"found":false} (never an error) — and it still charges the $0.008. Check `found` before reading fields.
Pricing (price_in/price_out and prices.*) is quoted in USD per 1,000,000 tokens, not per call.
benchmark / benchmarks can be null even when aider sources are listed in sources_used (was null for claude-sonnet-4); do not assume a benchmark is always present.
Data is fused from open keyless catalogs (LiteLLM, models.dev, Aider) with per-record citations[] and attribution[]; a `degraded[]` array lists any source that failed to contribute.
usage.guide: Look up one AI model's normalized metadata by name or short alias. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/model/lookup?name=<model-name-or-alias> — the single required query param `name` accepts a full model id or a short alias (e.g. sonnet, 4o, claude-sonnet-4-5, gpt-4o) and is fuzzy-resolved to the closest catalog model. No request body; the result is inline in the 200. Pays $0.008 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453), keyless. Returns a single record: found, id, name, provider, providers[] (all gateways carrying the model), aliases[], price_in/price_out (USD per 1M tokens) plus per-source prices.{input,output,cache_read}.{litellm,modelsdev}, context (context window), max_output, caps[] (tools/vision/reasoning/pdf/prompt_caching/structured_output), modalities.{input,output}, knowledge_cutoff, release_date, benchmark(s) (coding pass-rate or null), and citations[]/attribution[] (fused from LiteLLM, models.dev, Aider). Unknown names return {"found":false} with HTTP 200 (still billed), so pass a precise id/alias when you need an exact model and check `found` before reading fields.

entries.name: Agentstools Model Compare
entries.description: Compare two to five AI models side by side — each name/alias resolved and normalized to per-million input/output pricing, context and max-output limits, capability tags, knowledge cutoff, release date and best Aider coding benchmark, plus convenience picks (cheapest, best benchmark, largest context) and per-source citations; deterministic, no LLM.

models.description: Comma-separated list of two to five model names or aliases to compare, e.g. gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-5, gemini-2.5-flash. Each is fuzzy-resolved to the closest catalog model.

outputSchema.description: Side-by-side comparison. models[] is one normalized record per resolved name; not_found[] lists unresolved names; picks flags convenience winners.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/model/compare?models=<comma-separated-list>. Single required query param `models` (2-5 model names or aliases, comma-separated, e.g. gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-5, gemini-2.5-flash). No request body. Result is inline in the 200. Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453), keyless.
usage.outputShape: JSON object. models[] = one normalized record per resolved name (verified live for gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-5, gemini-2.5-flash): query, id, name, provider, price_in / price_out (USD per 1M tokens), prices.{input,output,cache_read}.{litellm,modelsdev} (per-source USD/1M), context (tokens), max_output, caps[] (e.g. tools, vision, reasoning, prompt_caching, structured_output, audio, pdf, parallel_tools), knowledge_cutoff, release_date, benchmark (Aider coding pass-rate object or null), citations[] (source+source_url+license). not_found[] lists unresolved names. picks holds convenience winners (cheapest, best_benchmark, largest_context) — a key is omitted when no model qualifies (best_benchmark absent when every benchmark is null). sources_used[], degraded[], attribution[] round it out.
quirks: Each `models` entry is fuzzy alias-resolved to the closest catalog model, so a resolved record may not be the exact/latest variant you meant. Pass precise ids/aliases when you need an exact match.
Pricing (price_in/price_out and prices.*) is quoted in USD per 1,000,000 tokens, not per call.

The top-level `provider` on each record reflects the first gateway in the catalog and can differ from the canonical vendor (live run showed provider:"302ai" for gpt-4o/claude-sonnet-4-5/gemini-2.5-flash rather than openai/anthropic/google).

benchmark can be null for well-known models even though aider sources are listed in sources_used (was null for all three in the live run); do not assume a benchmark is always present. When every benchmark is null, picks.best_benchmark is omitted entirely (live picks had only cheapest + largest_context).

Unresolved names do not error — they land in not_found[] and the call still charges the flat $0.01. Deterministic, no LLM; data fused from open keyless catalogs (LiteLLM, models.dev, Aider) with per-record citations and attribution.
usage.guide: Compare two to five AI models side by side. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/model/compare?models=<comma-separated-list> — the single required query param `models` takes 2-5 model names or aliases (full ids or short aliases, fuzzy-resolved). No request body; result inline in the 200. Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453), keyless. Returns models[] with one normalized record per resolved name (id, name, provider, price_in/price_out per 1M tokens plus per-source prices.{input,output,cache_read}.{litellm,modelsdev}, context, max_output, caps[], knowledge_cutoff, release_date, benchmark or null, citations[]), not_found[] for names that could not be resolved, and picks (cheapest / best_benchmark / largest_context — a pick key is dropped when no model qualifies). Deterministic, no LLM; fused from LiteLLM, models.dev and Aider with per-record citations. Prices are USD per 1M tokens, and the call still charges $0.01 even if some names land in not_found.

entries.name: Agentstools Model Route
entries.description: Route to the cheapest LLM that passes a task class (coding, reasoning, vision, tool-use, long-context, cheap-chat, general) plus optional constraints (min context, tool/vision/reasoning, max input/output price, min coding benchmark, provider) — returns a ranked cheapest-first candidate list with normalized per-million prices, context, capability tags and citations, a recommended pick and a deterministic rationale, fused from LiteLLM, models.dev and Aider.

task.description: Required. Workload class to route for. Each class implies required capabilities and a sensible context floor that explicit constraints override.

max_input_price.description: Maximum input price in USD per million tokens.

max_output_price.description: Maximum output price in USD per million tokens.

min_benchmark.description: Minimum Aider coding pass rate percent.

provider.description: Optional provider filter such as anthropic or openai.

outputSchema.description: Ranked routing result. Deterministic; no LLM runs.

recommended.description: Top pick: id, name, provider, price_in, price_out, blended, context, caps[], benchmark, citations[].

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/model/route?task=<class>&min_context=<int>&needs_tools=<bool>&max_output_price=<usd/1M>&... Only `task` is required (enum: coding, reasoning, vision, tool-use, long-context, cheap-chat, general); all constraints are optional query params. No request body. Result is inline in the 200. Pays $0.02 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453), keyless.
usage.outputShape: JSON routing result (verified live for task=coding, min_context=200000, needs_tools=true, max_output_price=10). Key fields: task, constraints_applied (echo of all constraints incl. defaults + sort), recommended (top pick object: id, name, provider, price_in, price_out, blended, sort_cost, context, caps[], benchmark or null, citations[]), candidates[] (up to ~15 cheapest-first, each same shape as recommended), candidate_count (total models passing — 967 in the verified run), rationale (deterministic string, e.g. 'Cheapest of 967 models passing [context >= 200,000; tool-use; output <= $10.0/1M] for task coding: inclusionai/ling-2.6-flash at $0.03/1M output. Ranked cheapest-first by blended price.'), sources_used[], degraded[] (sources that failed to contribute), attribution[] (LiteLLM/models.dev/Aider licenses), not_advice (disclaimer). Prices are USD per 1,000,000 tokens.
quirks: Only `task` is required; every other param is an optional filter. Constraints combine with AND and are echoed back in constraints_applied along with defaults (e.g. sort=blended, unset numeric filters shown as null).
Prices (price_in/price_out/blended) are USD per 1,000,000 tokens, not per call. Ranking is cheapest-first by a blended input/output price (sort_cost).

benchmark can be null for a recommended/candidate model even when aider sources are listed in sources_used (all candidates in the verified run had benchmark:null); do not assume the top pick has a coding benchmark.
candidates[] is a truncated preview (~15 shown) while candidate_count reports the full passing set; narrow with tighter constraints to focus the list.

Deterministic fusion of open keyless catalogs (LiteLLM, models.dev, Aider); a degraded[] array lists any source that failed, and not_advice reminds you to verify pricing/capabilities against each provider before production routing.
usage.guide: Route to the cheapest LLM that still passes a quality/capability bar for a task, then send sub-calls to it. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/model/route?task=<class>&<constraints...> — `task` is required (enum: coding, reasoning, vision, tool-use, long-context, cheap-chat, general); optional query params: min_context (tokens), needs_tools/needs_vision/needs_reasoning (bool), max_input_price/max_output_price (USD per 1M tokens), min_benchmark (Aider coding pass-rate %), provider (filter, e.g. anthropic/openai). No request body; result inline in the 200. Pays $0.02 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453), keyless. Returns constraints_applied, a cheapest-first candidates[] (each with normalized per-1M price_in/price_out/blended, context, caps[], benchmark or null, citations[]), candidate_count, a recommended top pick, a deterministic rationale string, sources_used/degraded, and attribution. Deterministic — no LLM runs. Prices are per 1M tokens; verify against the provider before production routing.
